postprocessing.operation: Recomputed latency/status fields from canonical receipts and recovered setup summaries from audited reports; no raw records, probabilities or costs changed.

receipt_scope: Canonical cumulative model records. Original stage journals and resource reports remain in audit/; no timing rows add task-quality evidence. Missing cells stay explicit.
